notes: «قال خطبنا عتبة بن غزوان»: Khalid reports the sermon, and the sermon's words are Utba's, so Utba is the last link (rule 6)
«سعد بن مالك» in the sermon is a participant in the story, not a link; «أما بعد» is not a name

fixes.reason: K6I's index stops at خالد بن عمير although the text names عتبة بن غزوان as the speaker of the sermon after him.
